description_en: Intelligent outbound call based on an LLM
description_zh: 基于大模型的智能外呼
name: LlmSmartCall

parameters.help_en: Called number that receives the intelligent outbound call
parameters.help_zh: 接收智能外呼的被叫号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en: Caller number. This parameter is required and supports only numbers from the Chinese mainland. View available numbers in the Voice Service Number Management (https://dyvmsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal) interface
parameters.help_zh:
主叫号码，为必填参数，仅支持中国内地号码。请前往语音服务真实号管理 (https://dyvmsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)界面查看号码。


若您使用的是自带线路，则需要传自带线路号码
parameters.name: caller_number

parameters.help_en: LLM application code. View it in the Application Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp) interface
parameters.help_zh: 大模型应用编码。在大模型应用管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp)界面查看
parameters.name: application_code

parameters.help_en: Start-word variables. Go to the LLM Application Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp) interface and click Details to view the start-word variables of your created LLM application
parameters.help_zh: 开场白变量。请前往大模型应用管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp)界面单击详情查看您创建的大模型开场白变量
parameters.name: start_word_param

parameters.help_en: Prompt variable. Go to the Application Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp) interface and click Details to view the prompt variables you created
parameters.help_zh: Prompt提示词变量。请前往大模型应用管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/llmApp)界面单击详情查看您创建的Prompt提示词变量
parameters.name: prompt_param

parameters.help_en: An ID reserved for the caller. This ID will be returned to the caller through a receipt message. Length: 1–15 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 预留给调用方使用的 ID，最终会通过回执消息将此 ID 带回给调用方，同时大模型网关请求客户模型时会将此参数带给客户模型，长度为 1~15 个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: Business parameters. These parameters are passed to the customer model when invoking the customer model
parameters.help_zh:
自定义业务参数，客户调用此接口时可以将自定义参数传递给大模型网关，大模型网关请求客户模型时会将此参数带给客户模型。

百炼工作流应用地址：参数传递 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/invoke-workflow-application/#6e644d5a7b3ia)。如：`biz_params = {"city": "杭州"}`

百炼智能体应用地址：传递自定义参数 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/call-single-agent-application/#b774db7cdc0aa)。如：
`
biz_params = {
  "user_prompt_params": "{\"city\":\"北京\"}"
}
`
parameters.name: biz_param

parameters.help_en:
The extension number of the X number, up to 5 digits.

<notice>Fill this field only in AXN extension mode. If no extension number exists, do not fill it.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
X号码的分机号码，不超过5位。

<notice>仅在AXN分机号模式下需要填写，如果不存在分机号，请务必不要填写。></notice>
parameters.name: extension

parameters.help_en:
Maximum call duration. The call is automatically disconnected after timeout. Unit: seconds.

Maximum value: 3600 s.
Minimum value: 600 s
parameters.help_zh:
最大通话时长，超时后自动挂断。单位：秒。

最大取值：3600s。
最小取值：600s
parameters.name: session_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The voice code used for TTS playback.

If no value is set, the voice code configured in the LLM application is used by default.
You can use the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926668.html API to view all available voice codes
parameters.help_zh:
TTS 播放时的音色编码。


不设置值时，默认取大模型应用配置的音色编码。
支持通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926668.html接口查看全部音色编码
parameters.name: tts_voice_code

parameters.help_en:
Voice speed during TTS playback.


Value range: -200 to 200. Default value is 0.
If this parameter is not set, the voice speed configured in the LLM application is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
TTS 播放时的声音速度。


取值范围：-200~200，默认值为0。
不设置值时，默认取大模型应用配置的声音速度
parameters.name: tts_speed

parameters.help_en:
The volume for TTS playback.

Value range: 0–100. Default value is 0.
If no value is set, the volume configured in the LLM application is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
TTS 播放的音量。

取值范围：0~100，默认值为0。
不设置值时，默认取大模型应用配置的音量
parameters.name: tts_volume

parameters.help_en:
Customer-provided ingest endpoint encoding.


If you use your own line, contact Alibaba Cloud support to enable this feature.
The line encoding is provided by Alibaba Cloud support. Do not set this parameter if you do not have one
parameters.help_zh:
用户自带线路编码。

如果需要使用自带线路，请联系运营开通此功能；自带线路审核通过后会返回线路编码，若无，请不要设置值
parameters.name: customer_line_code

CallId.description_en: Unique receipt ID for this call

Code.description_en: Request status code. A return value of "OK" indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功
